entities.summary: Danil Vadimovich Gushchin is a Russian professional ice hockey right winger for the Colorado Eagles of the American Hockey League (AHL), while under contract to the Colorado Avalanche of the National Hockey League (NHL). Selected by the San Jose Sharks in the 2020 NHL entry draft, he made his NHL debut with them in 2023.
